reasons: The Datadog query is nginx.net.conn_dropped_per_s, a count of dropped connections per second. No OTel metric in the definitions measures dropped connections directly.
The candidate subtracts nginx.connections_handled from itself. Both operands are identical, so the result is always zero and does not represent dropped connections.

The candidate derives a value from other metrics (dropped = accepted - handled style logic). The rules require blocking with MISSING_METRIC_MAPPING and putting any proposed derivation in notes, not in promql.
The outcome should be blocked with MISSING_METRIC_MAPPING, not translated.
Summing and rate-of-monotonic-sum usage are structurally fine, but they do not rescue the wrong quantity.
